question: Does knowing a cause-effect relation by itself guarantee liberation?
premises: Liberation is the manifestation of the Self.
A mere effect produced from a cause does not amount to that manifestation.
Knowing a cause-effect relation does not by itself bring liberation.
inference: Therefore liberation cannot be reduced to an ordinary causal product or to mere causal knowledge.
uncertainties: The compressed phrase kāraṇātkārya is read as denying a merely causal model of liberation.
plain_english: Since liberation is the manifestation of the Self, one should not think that merely knowing a cause and its effect is enough to make someone free.
